get.description:
Retrieves a report of game feedback submitted by players within a specified date range. The date range cannot exceed six months. This endpoint is restricted to Superadmins.

Actors:
  • Superadmin

400.description: Bad Request - Missing or invalid date parameters, or date range exceeds six months.

403.description: Forbidden - Caller is not a Superadmin.

get.description:
Retrieves a usage history for a specific sensor, identifying the most recent admin to use it within a specified date range. It returns the latest admin, the timestamp of the last use, and a sorted list of all admins who used the sensor during that period.

Actors:
  • Superadmin

parameters.name: sensorName
parameters.description: The name or identifier of the sensor to report on.

403.description: Forbidden - Caller is not a Superadmin.

get.description:
(v4) Retrieves a detailed report of session data for players, with advanced, flexible filtering and improved performance. This endpoint can return a JSON response, generate graph data, and provide a URL to download the full report as a CSV file. - **Filtering Priority:** The endpoint evaluates query parameters in the following order: \`orgIDs\`, then \`adminIDs\`, then \`playerIDs\`. - **"all" Keyword:** For \`playerIDs\`, \`adminIDs\`, and \`orgIDs\`, you can use the keyword "all" to report on all entities accessible to the caller. - **Default Behavior:** If no ID filters are provided, the report defaults to all players accessible by the caller based on their role.
Actors:
  • Superadmin
  • Organisation
  • Admin

400.description: Bad Request - Invalid parameters, such as an incorrect date format or invalid graph frequency.

403.description: Forbidden - The caller is not authorized to access the requested data.

get.description:

Actors:

get.description:
Retrieves a list of players with their basic details. The list can be filtered by a specific user (organisation or admin) by providing a `userID`. If no `userID` is provided, it returns players associated with the caller. The response includes details about the primary admin and any secondary admins linked to each player.

The `adminID` query parameter is supported for legacy purposes but `userID` should be used for new development; `userID` takes precedence.

Actors:
  • Superadmin
  • Linked Org
  • Linked Admin

parameters.name: userID
parameters.description: Optional ID of an organisation or admin to filter the player list. If omitted, returns players for the caller.

get.description:
Generates a consolidated report of player session data, aggregated by a specified frequency. This endpoint can filter sessions by various criteria and returns a flattened JSON report along with a URL to download a full CSV version.

Filtering:
  • Use one of \`playerIDs\`, \`adminIDs\`, or \`orgIDs\` for filtering, but not more than one at a time.
  • If no ID-based filter is provided, the report includes all players accessible to the caller.
Actors:
  • Superadmin
  • Linked Organisation
  • Linked Admin

200.description: Successfully retrieved the consolidated session report.

400.description: Bad Request - Invalid parameters provided, such as using multiple ID filters.

403.description: Forbidden - The caller is not authorized to access the requested data.

get.description:
Generates a consolidated report of admin session data, aggregated by a specified frequency. This endpoint can filter sessions by various criteria and returns a flattened JSON report along with a URL to download a full CSV version.

Filtering:
  • If \`adminIDs\` is provided, the report is generated for those specific admins.
  • If \`orgIDs\` is provided, the report includes all admins linked to those organisations.
  • If neither is provided, the report includes all admins accessible to the caller.
Actors:
  • Superadmin
  • Linked Organisation
  • Linked Admin

parameters.name: adminIDs
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of admin IDs to include in the report.

parameters.name: orgIDs
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of organisation IDs to include in the report.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the consolidated session report.

403.description: Forbidden - The caller is not authorized to access the requested data.

get.description:
Generates a consolidated report of organisation session data, aggregated by a specified frequency. This endpoint can filter sessions by various criteria and returns a flattened JSON report along with a URL to download a full CSV version.

Filtering:
  • If \`orgIDs\` is provided, the report is generated for those specific organisations.
  • If \`orgIDs\` is omitted, the report includes all organisations accessible to the caller (Superadmin only).
Actors:
  • Superadmin

parameters.name: orgIDs
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of organisation IDs to include in the report.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the consolidated session report.

403.description: Forbidden - The caller is not authorized to access the requested data.

get.description:
Retrieves a summary of notifications. By default, it returns only active notifications, but can include all (active and expired) by setting the `active` query parameter to `false`. This endpoint is restricted to Superadmins.

Actors:
  • Superadmin

403.description: Forbidden - Caller is not a Superadmin.

get.description:

Actors:
  • Superadmin

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier for the notification.

400.description: Bad Request - The notification with the specified ID does not exist.

403.description: Forbidden - Caller is not a Superadmin.

get.description:
Retrieves a Net Promoter Score (NPS) report based on survey responses within a specified date range. The report can be filtered by `adminIDs` and/or `orgIDs`. It calculates the overall NPS, provides a detailed list of responses, and generates a downloadable Excel file of the report.

Actors:
  • Superadmin

400.description: Bad Request - Missing or invalid parameters, such as `adminIDs` or date range.

403.description: Forbidden - The caller is not a Superadmin.

404.description: Not Found - No survey data found.

get.description:
Retrieves application logs within a specified date range. This endpoint is restricted to Superadmins and returns a list of log entries, including details about the caller and the log event itself. The `stackTrace` field is excluded from the response.

Actors:
  • Superadmin

400.description: Bad Request - Missing or invalid date parameters.

403.description: Forbidden - Caller is not a Superadmin.
